WITH locked AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT futures_outcomes.id AS id, given.ord AS ord, given.price AS price, given.compared AS compared 
FROM unnest($1::INTEGER[], $2::NUMERIC(7, 6)[], $3::FLOAT[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS given(id, price, compared, ord) JOIN futures_outcomes ON futures_outcomes.id = given.id ORDER BY given.ord FOR UPDATE OF futures_outcomes)
 UPDATE futures_outcomes SET current_probability=locked.price, last_updated=now(), price_changed_at=CASE WHEN (CAST(futures_outcomes.current_probability AS NUMERIC(7, 6)) IS DISTINCT FROM CAST(locked.compared AS NUMERIC(7, 6))) THEN now() ELSE futures_outcomes.price_changed_at END FROM locked WHERE futures_outcomes.id = locked.id RETURNING locked.ord, futures_outcomes.id, futures_outcomes.market_id, futures_outcomes.last_updated, futures_outcomes.price_changed_at = futures_outcomes.last_updated AS quote_moved
